title: See who's won an Emmy Award so far
content: Law & Order: SVU star Mariska Hargitay is hosting the Emmy Awards on Monday night. We'll be updating this list as winners are announced.

title: The Supreme Court rejects Trump's mail voting restrictions for this year's midterms
content: The Supreme Court has rejected the Trump administration's request to allow mail-in voting restrictions under a U.S. Postal Service plan for the midterm general election.

title: Mitch McConnell returns to Senate after fall that led to an extended medical absence
content: McConnell spent weeks in recovery before explaining he was "briefly unconscious" following the fall that sent him to the hospital and a weeks-long recovery process.

title: Federal agents may have broken state laws in voter fraud hunt, whistleblower claims
content: Federal agents may have broken state laws after the Department of Homeland Security began surging personnel for what it called the Unlawful Voter Initiative, a federal whistleblower alleges.

title: Trump's EPA repeals pollution limits on fossil fuel power plants
content: The Trump administration is eliminating limits on climate-warming pollution from the nation's fossil fuel power plants. Environmental groups say this will impact the climate and public health.

title: Israel is 'dismantling Palestinian life' says Israeli human rights group
content: One of the country's leading human rights organizations says Israel is dismantling all aspects of Palestinian life at a breakneck rate. The group has extensively documented what it says are the mechanisms Israel has used to "ethnically cleanse" the West Bank of Palestinians.

title: 10 years after taking a knee, Colin Kaepernick is still waging a 'Perilous Fight'
content: The former 49ers quarterback created an uproar in 2016 when took a knee during the national anthem to protest police brutality. In The Perilous Fight he explains why he still wants to play football.

title: Kennedy Center says it's on the brink of bankruptcy, might close as early as Tuesday
content: In two board resolutions made public Monday, the arts institution says it is in a dire financial and physical state — and that only President Trump can "rescue" it.

title: The producer of Fleabag and Baby Reindeer's tip for finding a hit? Don't look for one
content: Theatre producer Francesca Moody has a remarkable record of spotting shows that go on to have wide success. At the Edinburgh Fringe festival, she told NPR about what she looks for in a performance.

title: Key leaders sound the alarm on AI. And, Iran-Gulf diplomacy hits a setback
content: Some key leaders at artificial intelligence companies call for a slowdown in AI development. And, Iran-Gulf diplomacy hits a setback as talks in Oman are delayed.
